title: About DarGlobal — International Luxury Real Estate Developer
raw_content:
About DarGlobal

DarGlobal is the international luxury real estate development arm of Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company, a renowned Saudi real estate conglomerate with nearly three decades of market leadership.

Established in 2017 and headquartered in London, United Kingdom, DarGlobal focuses on developing luxury second homes and prime vacation properties in international high-demand destinations across the Middle East and Europe, including the United Arab Emirates, the Sultanate of Oman, Qatar, Spain, the United Kingdom, and Saudi Arabia.

DarGlobal is officially listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol DAR.

The company is distinguished by its exclusive collaborations with prestigious global luxury brands, including Automobili Lamborghini, Pagani Automobili, Missoni, Elie Saab, Aston Martin, and Trump International.
